instruction: 老板否定平滑清理版，要求维持指定原图画风；本版回到指定原图仅轻修，随后老板明确实装。

items.prompt:
MINIMAL CLEANUP EDIT, NOT A STYLE TRANSFER OR A GLOBAL REDRAW. The attached selected image is the painting to preserve. Its original painterly technique is mandatory and is the most important requirement. Keep its original angular opaque block-brush marks, layered cool-gray silver hair, sharp blue cloth facets, broken painted highlights, varied small and broad stroke density, and handcrafted edges. Do not replace these with smooth shaded anime, rounded ribbons of hair, clean vector-like fabric, glossy airbrush, generic polished rendering or a different Arknights interpretation. The original itself defines the desired style. Previous cleanup was rejected specifically for smoothing away the painting style.
Keep the original camera, close motorcycle crop, pose, limb and hand placements, face proportions/expression, colors, props, full background layout and every major form. Retain the same face rather than redesigning eyes or jaw. Keep the low sunglasses, blue bow, silver ponytail, royal-blue shirt, black shorts and boots.
Only make very small local cleanup where truly needed: remove a few stray line fragments that do not connect to a hair lock or mechanical structure; remove duplicated tiny white specks and incoherent edge nicks; gently clarify eyelid and iris boundaries and the existing fang smile, without changing the eye shape, gaze or face. Keep all purposeful narrow hair strands, angular hair planes, shirt folds, rough hard-edged paint layering and cool shadow patches. Preserve the original nonuniform brush texture and surface complexity, including substantial detail in hair and clothes. Do NOT broadly simplify the skin shading or homogenize the limbs; keep the original painterly planes with only isolated implausible spots cleaned. Preserve the motorcycle's painted metallic texture, engine fin groupings and hand-painted imperfect edge character. Background cherry blossoms and foliage should retain the original painting, not be replaced by generic blurred masses.
Clarity should come from repairing a few uncertain focal edges and removing isolated distracting artifacts, NOT from smoothing, sharpening filters, adding micro-detail, changing paint technique or repainting the whole image. Aim for 90-95% of the original painting to remain visually the same, with subtle retouching. No text, watermark, frame, new items, changed lighting or shifted composition.
